generation.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: editorial image for Korean Himawari bag journal, landscape 3:2. Use image 1 as exact reference for the black Himawari No.0422 backpack. Preserve exact product design, rounded top, top handle, front pockets, circular pouch, charms, logo, proportions and black fabric. Show the same backpack placed upright beside a neat entryway tray with keys and a folded notebook, warm natural daylight, calm minimal home interior, realistic product photography, no people, no extra bags, no text, no watermark. The backpack must remain the clear focus and must not gain or lose pockets or accessories.
